Team —

Quick one: finance flagged a few EMEA opportunities that look like they may be double-counted in our Q3 commit. I pulled a short overlap report (attached) and highlighted where two sellers or multiple regions have the same account/opportunity created in SFDC with overlapping close dates. We need a tidy cut to avoid inflated commit numbers for the July close.

Action requested by EOD Wed (30 Jun):
- Owners in the list below, confirm the single canonical opportunity and move duplicates to "Stalled" or close as appropriate.
- If you intend to keep multiple opportunities, add a note in the SFDC Opportunity comments with rationale and expected net-new ARR contribution.
- Finance needs final, reconciled commit numbers by Thu morning for forecasting.

Top items (subset):
- HelioBank — two Opps (regional sales + channel). Suspected double-count. Suggested canonical: HLB-Regional-2027-Q3.
- FjordTech — two Opps with slightly different ACV. Looks like procurement re-engaged after a prior POC.
- NordicTel — duplicate created during AE handoff; one should be closed as duplicate.

I assigned suspected owners in the CSV. Please reply with the one-line confirmation (e.g., "HelioBank canonical = HLB-Regional-2027-Q3; duplicate closed"). If you need an extension, call it out here.

Attachments: overlap_report_q3.csv (stub)

Thanks — Priya
